verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Boards are documented as shareable workspaces where users save and organize queries and visualizations, which covers the shareable-dashboard core. The evidence does not show a range of visualization types or any template-variable mechanism. Board Templates are pre-built boards, not dashboard variables. Missing for 10: documented rich visualization types, template/dashboard variables, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: A Board is a workspace where you can save, organize, and share analysis components focused on a common objective.
Learn how Boards work as centralized workspaces to organize queries, monitor SLOs, collaborate with teammates, and save visualizations for reuse and sharing.
